rationale: Ships non-breaking for third-party/user loops carrying a stray evaluate: key today. fsm-loop-schema.json already sets additionalProperties: false on evaluateConfig (an ERROR stance on the JSON-schema side), so the Python loader intentionally stays more permissive than the schema for now; revisit ERROR-at-load once WARN-rule telemetry confirms no live population depends on a stray key being silently accepted.
rule: MR-14 (evaluate: unknown-key detection) ships as ll-loop validate WARN severity now; ERROR-at-load is deferred until built-in and user-loop telemetry shows the population is clean
alternatives_rejected: ERROR-at-load immediately: rejected because it would be a breaking change for any third-party/user loop currently carrying a stray evaluate: key, even though the built-in-loop sweep is already clean.
